statement: NVIDIA's China revenue fell to $4.55 billion in the quarter cited from $9.66 billion a year earlier, per figures reported in the piece.
why: A roughly halved China revenue line removes a large regional pool from the merchant-GPU demand base and explains the intensity of the vendors' lobbying.

impact.mechanism: Export licensing limits cut shipments into China, reducing reported regional data-center revenue for the merchant-GPU vendors.

evidence.excerpt: NVIDIA's China revenue fell to '$4.55 billion (Q1) from $9.66 billion year-over-year'

confidence.basis: Figures quoted secondhand in a secondary aggregation, not read from the vendor's own filing.
